where: Exam traps, third bullet (trap 2 on H not being NOT)
problem: The claim "only X takes |0⟩ to |1⟩" is not exactly true: Y|0⟩ = i|1⟩, which is the state |1⟩ up to a global phase, so a measurement on Y|0⟩ also gives 1 with certainty. The chapter itself teaches that global phase is unobservable, so this sentence contradicts it and can confuse a student.
fix: Say: "X takes |0⟩ exactly to |1⟩; H|0⟩ = |+⟩, not |1⟩, and Y|0⟩ = i|1⟩ differs from |1⟩ only by a global phase."
